gen-righteous-gf-days-one: Righteous cuts its letters like bent steel rod, full bowls and uniform strokes throughout. Days One sits next to it with rope-ladder spacing and a chunky lowercase, a friendlier sans that lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-righteous-gf-epunda-sans: Bent-rod letters with no hairline anywhere give Righteous its fun, commanding look. Epunda Sans follows with oversized openings inside its curves and trimmed sidebearings, so paragraphs move along smoothly without a trace of fuss.
gen-righteous-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads like nails lined up on a ruler, structured and exact. Righteous brings a bent-rod swagger above it, full bowls against that monospace grid, and the longer text keeps a steady, orderly pace beneath.
gen-righteous-gf-geom: Geom reads with a lofty lowercase band and a friendly, modern manner. Righteous, drawn with no stroke contrast at all, makes the strongest single impression here: bold bent-rod shapes sitting over a plain sans that stays out of its way.
gen-righteous-gf-krona-one: Heavy, loose, and a bit industrial. Krona One spreads its cast-iron lowercase out with generous spacing, so a long page under Righteous, whose t has crossbar and stem of matching weight, reads slowly and steadily.
gen-righteous-gf-magra: Righteous draws every letter as if with a technical pen, full bowls and fun authority. Magra follows with a big-bodied lowercase in a sans that holds up the text, while the heading handles the loud introductions.
gen-righteous-gf-momo-trust-display: Momo Trust Display lets its letters drift apart, with a generous x-height that gives text room to breathe. Righteous sits above it with identical vertical and horizontal strokes, loud against the quiet.
gen-righteous-gf-mukta: Righteous has no calligraphic thinning, just full bowls bent from steel rod. Its strongest quality is the commanding, playful punch it gives Mukta, whose lofty small letters keep the sans-serif text clean and neutral.
gen-righteous-gf-mukta-mahee: Chunky and cheerful, with steel-rod strokes of one thickness everywhere in Righteous, set over a sturdier body. Its strongest quality is Mukta Mahee's approachable, stocky lowercase, sitting happily beneath that heading.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-display: Full-bowled and bold, Righteous bends every letter like steel rod without a single swelling curve. Noto Sans Display brings the strongest quality, a big middle zone in every word, as a plain sans.
